props.gloss_en: the mishna: [a lung] shriveled by the hand of Heaven -- fit
which is a charuta? any [animal] whose lung shriveled
the baraita: by the hand of Heaven -- fit
the baraita: by human hands -- tereifa
R' Shimon ben Elazar: even by the hands of any creature
R' Shimon ben Elazar stands on the first clause, and to leniency [shriveling by any creature counts with 'by the hand of Heaven' -- fit]
or he stands on the last clause, and to stringency [shriveling by any creature counts with 'by human hands' -- tereifa]
the baraita: [a lung] shriveled by human hands -- tereifa; R' Shimon ben Elazar says: even by the hands of any creature
Rabba bar bar Chana found rams whose lungs were shriveled and came and asked in the study hall [how the cause is to be determined]
in summer: bring white vessels, fill them with cold water, and set [the lungs] in them a full day
in winter: bring dark vessels, fill them with tepid water, and set [the lungs] in them a full day
if they become healthy again, it is by the hand of Heaven
if it becomes healthy again -- fit
